name_note: Genomes GTDB places in this genus carry the NCBI names Blautia, Oliverpabstia and Ruminococcus; the species named in the retrieved literature is Oliverpabstia intestinalis.

sentences.text: In an ex vivo study of the adult gut microbiome, galacto-oligosaccharides enriched specific Lachnospiraceae species, a list that included Oliverpabstia intestinalis.
In an anti-inflammatory dietary intervention study, Oliverpabstia and Fusicatenibacter were depleted following the intervention, while Anaerostipes and Limivivens were enriched among responders.
A lifestyle intervention study reported increased levels of genera it described as butyrate-producing and anti-inflammatory, including Oliverpabstia.
